integrity: All infinite-time statements are proved analytically using scalar factorization, integration, the strong law and the classical law of the iterated logarithm. The finite standalone checker is supplemental.
scientific_limitations: Two intersecting real planar lines, common sigma ratio, independently uniform arclength selections on the full feasible projection segment. Other stochastic selection laws, set geometries, finite-precision implementations and higher dimensions are not covered.
title: Three sharp stability thresholds for uniformly randomized quasioptimal alternating projections
